LESSON: READING 9.2.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read fictional materials? 2. What should you consider when selecting fictional texts for reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. select a variety of fictional texts for extensive reading,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. read fictional texts for information and enjoyment,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the importance of fiction in life.  Identify fictional material to read by looking at the cover page, blurb, and title. Learners who may not turn pages to use page-turners or be supported by peers. They could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate adapted digital devices to record findings.  Read texts on varied issues such as national heroes and heroines and discuss the elements of fiction in the text,  List down words and phrases encountered,  Re-tell the story in their own words. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views. Allow more time for learners with speech difficulties to express their views. 1. B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Grade- appropriate fiction materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
